PEDAL.description: PEDAL區域精細分析範圍，diff_threshold用於前後幀比較，cache_hit_threshold用於cache匹配

AS.description: Active Sentry icon below Vac (machine 2 only). The white glyph is selected by colour; RMSE 10-15 when shown, 70 when absent.

STATUS.description: Status message on a translucent panel below Vac. Only Occlusion (red text) is tracked; the panel also shows Vent (black text), which has no template and so never matches. Text is selected by colour so what shows through the panel is ignored. RMSE <= 50 Occlusion, >= 106 Vent, >= 75 no panel.
